summary: MSVC CRT __setjmp3 implementation: saves the non-volatile registers (EBP, EBX, EDI, ESI), the stack pointer and return address, the current SEH exception list, and the jmp_buf signature constant 1447244336 into the caller's jmp_buf a5; records either the previous exception handler or a caller-supplied handler plus up to 6 trailing varargs dwords depending on the mode operand a6; returns 0.

local_names.a1: EBX value saved into jmp_buf slot 1
local_names.a2: EBP value saved into jmp_buf slot 0
local_names.a3: EDI value saved into jmp_buf slot 2
local_names.a4: ESI value saved into jmp_buf slot 3
local_names.a6: registration mode: 0 = plain save, 1 = current-handler path, 2..8 = handler with trailing varargs
local_names.a7: replacement SEH exception-list head used on the handler path
local_names.a8: handler value stored into slot 7 and va_start anchor
local_names.v9: clamped count of trailing varargs dwords

operations.description: Save the register context into jmp_buf a5: a5[0] = a2 (EBP), a5[1] = a1 (EBX), a5[2] = a3 (EDI), a5[3] = a4 (ESI), a5[4] = &retaddr (stack pointer at call time), a5[5] = retaddr (return address).
Write the jmp_buf signature and mode slot: a5[8] = 1447244336, a5[9] = 0.
ExceptionList = NtCurrentTeb()->NtTib.ExceptionList; a5[6] = ExceptionList stores the current SEH exception-list head.
If ExceptionList == -1 (no SEH chain), a5[7] = -1 records a null handler.
Else-if a6 is non-zero and a6 != 1, with side effects ExceptionList = a7 and a5[9] = a7: take the caller-supplied handler path.
Handler path: a5[7] = a8 stores the caller-supplied handler value.
v9 = a6 - 2; when a6 != 2, clamp v9 to a maximum of 6; then qmemcpy(a5 + 10, va, 4 * v9) copies up to 6 trailing varargs dwords into the jmp_buf.
Else branch (plain or current-handler path): a5[7] = ExceptionList[1].Handler stores the prior exception handler as the jump target.

clean_pseudocode: else if (a6 && (ExceptionList=a7, a5[9]=a7, a6 != 1)) { a5[7] = a8; v9 = a6 - 2; if (a6 != 2) { if (v9 > 6) v9 = 6; qmemcpy(a5 + 10, va, 4 * v9); } }
